title: Prospective protocol: bottleneck migration under abundant AI implementation
primary_question: As implementation capacity increases, does the binding constraint on reliable software-development throughput move away from code production toward other stages?
exclusion_rules: Exclude only prospectively ineligible task, corrupted identity, invalid oracle/harness, or environment failure that makes the assigned contrast unavailable
Do not exclude candidate/task failures, timeouts, nulls, difficult implementations, valid gate failures, or negative outcomes
Apply without aggregate condition outcomes; retain excluded records with reason and condition
If exclusions exceed 20% overall or differ by >=10 percentage points between conditions, determination is INDETERMINATE unless BLOCKED precedence applies

source_boundary.allowed: Issue #109 Runs 1–3 and cross-run package only as bounded observations identifying variables/confounders
source_boundary.prohibited: treating #109 as proof, baseline effect estimate, abundance manipulation, causal evidence, or generalizable outcome
